per_candidate.id: s2:Constraints on jet contents derived from multimessenger studies of gamma-ray bur

rationale: Paper 2410.02315 provides evidence on the emission mechanisms of LGRBs and llGRBs by discussing the role of relativistic jets and their less-extreme counterparts, contributing to understanding their progenitor systems. However, it does not fully settle the question regarding the relationship with associated supernovae.
